about.text: Petitioner Keresa Richardson filed this action against the State of Texas, Governor Greg Abbott, and Secretary of State Jane Nelson, in their official capacities, alleging they violated § 2 of the Voting Rights Act and various federal and state constitutional provisions by failing to reapportion Texas’s appellate court districts.
